content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal is a single word-level edit to 14.2 — flipping ownership to Customer and adding Vendor's assignment — with the remaining preferred elements (Vendor Technology retention, the perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free embedded-IP licence in 13.2/14.3, Customer Data rights in 14.1, and no joint ownership in 14.4) mapped as already met from the cited paragraphs. The extra added sentence and "upon its creation" wording were removed, and the official minimality gate now passes.
